mapper.select:
select * from ( SELECT mp.ID, mp.MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, mp.MACHINE_CODE, mp.STATUS, mp.REMARK, mp.IS_DELETE, mp.CREATE_BY, mp.CREATE_TIME, mp.UPDATE_BY, mp.UPDATE_TIME, mi.MACHINE_NAME FROM T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE mp LEFT JOIN T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO mi ON mp.MACHINE_CODE = mi.MACHINE_CODE where mp.is_delete = '0'
and INSTR(mp.mouth_plate_code, #{mouthPlateCode}) > 0
and mp.machine_code = #{machineCode} and mp.status = #{status} order by mp.create_time desc ) t
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE ( mouth_plate_code, machine_code, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete ) VALUES
( #{MouthPlate.mouthPlateCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MouthPlate.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MouthPlate.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MouthPlate.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{MouthPlate.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{MouthPlate.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), update_by = VALUES(create_by), update_time = NOW(), remark = VALUES(remark)
mapper.update: update T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE set is_delete = '1' where is_delete = '0'
